text: App is smooth and the UPI money flow is instant. Bought my first index fund in five minutes
Redeemed my mutual fund after 3 days and got cut something called exit load. Nothing told me about this before I invested. Why is exit load not shown at the time of purchase?
UI is clean but the order screen hides charges until the last step.
I redeemed my SIP early and saw an exit load deduction in the statement. Support said it is standard but the app never explained how much or when it applies.
Love the smallcase integration and the price alerts. Keeps me from checking three different apps.
What exactly is exit load? Invested 20000 in a fund, took it out after a week, and 200 rupees disappeared. No tooltip, no FAQ link, nothing.
Charting is decent for a broker app. Would love a dark mode timer on the dashboard.
Customer support resolved my KYC issue in under an hour. Impressed.
Exit load confusion cost me money. The fund page shows returns but not the charges you eat when you redeem early. Please add a fee breakdown before confirming.
Account opening was fully online and took two days. eMandate setup was clear.
Prices sometimes lag by a few seconds during market hours which made me panic sell once.
I still do not understand exit load. Is it a penalty or a fee? Groww should show an example with real numbers on the fund page.
Gold and FD options in one app is convenient. Interest rates are shown upfront.
Blocked my sell order because of a settlement rule nobody explained. Took three support chats to understand it.
Portfolio XIRR calculation matches my own spreadsheet. Trustworthy.
Too many notifications about IPOs and ETFs. Let me mute categories.
The fund factsheet link is buried under three taps. Fees and load details should be one tap away.
Switched from another broker. Zero brokerage on equity delivery is real and the contract notes back it up.
Lost money to exit load because the app let me redeem without any warning about the charge. Fix the confirmation screen.
Watchlist sync across devices works flawlessly now.
Overall a good app but the fee and charges section is confusing and incomplete.
